thought.text: I found that PHP, Composer, Node, and npm are missing on this Ubuntu 22.04 system (which has PHP 8.1, but the project needs PHP 8.2+ and Node 22). Now I'll check network connectivity to determine the best way to install the required versions.

reasoning_content:
The repo has already been checked out to /workspace (the guide says to clone, but the repo already exists — this is fine. The ENVIRONMENT section states that the project's repo has already been checked out). What needs to be done:

1. Install PHP 8.2 (Ubuntu 22.04's default is 8.1 — on Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy), the default PHP in the `php` package is 8.1. PHP 8.2 is required. Options:
   - Use the ondrej/php PPA (requires add-apt-repository / software-properties-common)
   - The Ubuntu 22.04 repos only have php8.1. Laravel 12 requires PHP ^8.2.

2. Install Composer 2
3. Node.js 22 — Ubuntu 22.04's nodejs is 12. Need Node 22 from NodeSource, or nvm, or prebuilt binaries from nodejs.org.

Check network access first, then:

Plan:
- apt-get update
- Install php8.2 from the ondrej PPA (need software-properties-common, or manually add the PPA source) — actually, on jammy, ondrej's ppa has php8.2, php8.3, php8.4 available.
- PHP extensions: php8.2-sqlite3, php8.2-mbstring, php8.2-xml, php8.2-curl, php8.2-fileinfo (fileinfo is bundled with the main php8.2 package), php8.2-cli.
- Composer: download the installer from getcomposer.org.
- Node 22: download the tarball from nodejs.org (official binary), or NodeSource's apt. The tarball is simple and reliable: https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.x.x/node-v22.x.x-linux-x64.tar.xz.

First, check connectivity to these hosts.
